accountNull: CREATE no account; EDIT preserve existing account credentials/name/login flag, but staff role/hall/employment changes still revoke old sessions and advance account versions
readback: Read existing W3 staff detail after success to receive actual linked account id/version; no account id added to strict four-key write result
rules: ADMIN only via shared global administrator mutex -> original actor/key -> current identity -> sorted target account -> sorted target staff locks
Staff root version increments once; changed existing child account version/auth_version each increment once and all unrevoked sessions revoke in same original transaction
No staff/account identity rebind/removal; actual account creation timestamp preserved at microsecond precision
LEAVE changes 在职 to 离职 and disables current linked login; REINSTATE changes 离职 to 在职 and keeps login disabled, never automatic enable
Role/hall changes invalidate existing sessions; unrelated name/contact change preserves account row and sessions unless explicit account fields change
Last actual usable ADMIN cannot be removed by employment/role/login change
Selected new/restored hall must exist and be enabled; existing historical hall references preserved on leave
Password replaced with private stable HMAC for request fingerprint only; no password/hash/tag in safe audit or receipt
LEAVE/REINSTATE safe accounts arrays are full actual sets, including explicit [] for staff with no account; optional account CREATE/EDIT uses full actual before/after sets
pendingSharedContract: prepare interface and five leaf consumers implemented/fixed; D1 runtime must supply actual same-transaction prepare
Real engine B safety matrix and target deployment remain separately verified
D1/C private credential-key loading and host composition remain required

500: sanitized INTERNAL_ERROR; recover using original request key

prepareReadinessError.meaning: Exact application-owned code only: same original key was checked first; prepare function unavailable; rejection occurs before putStaff/putAccount/session mutation. No business write/receipt is completed by this attempt. This does not assert that every503 or uncertain transport is safe to resend.
prepareReadinessError.evidence: staff-maintenance-service.ts getReceipt -> authorization -> validate -> require prepare -> prepare -> putStaff/putAccount -> complete; W10-prepare tests and W10-prepare-http-run1.tap
prepareReadinessError.recovery: Keep original request key and exact submitted command. F3 existing uncertain/receipt recovery is safe and remains accepted. Recheck GET /staff/receipts/:requestKey with current permission; if committed use result. If unavailable/uncertain keep pending; never create a replacement key. Only after confirmed readiness and an explicit retry decision submit unchanged command under the SAME key. No automatic retry solely from HTTP503.
prepareReadinessError.unknownCommit: 500, proxy503, network loss, malformed/unknown body and generic readiness errors do not prove noncommit; original receipt recovery required.
prepareReadinessError.staleVersion: If retry yields VERSION_CONFLICT, reload actual detail and resolve deliberately; do not silently replace expectedVersion or mutate original body.
